mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team (name, description, avatar, visibility, status, owner_personnel_id, max_members, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{avatar}, #{visibility}, #{status}, #{ownerPersonnelId}, #{maxMembers}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE team SET owner_personnel_id = #{ownerPersonnelId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE team SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM team WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM team t WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT t.* FROM team t LEFT JOIN team_member m ON m.team_id = t.id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (t.owner_personnel_id = #{personnelId} OR m.personnel_id = #{personnelId}) GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY (t.owner_personnel_id = #{personnelId}) DESC, t.id ASC
SELECT name FROM personnel WHERE id = #{personnelId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_member (team_id, personnel_id, role_code, joined_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{personnelId}, #{roleCode}, NOW())

INSERT INTO team_member (team_id, personnel_id, role_code, joined_at, deleted) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{personnelId}, #{roleCode}, NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_code = VALUES(role_code), deleted = 0, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE team_member SET role_code = #{roleCode}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{memberId}
UPDATE team_member SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM team_member WHERE id = #{memberId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM team_member WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND personnel_id = #{personnelId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS memberId, m.personnel_id AS personnelId, p.name AS name, p.staff_id AS staffId, p.aro_user_id AS aroUserId, p.job_number AS jobNumber, p.department_name AS departmentName, p.project_group_name AS projectGroupName, m.role_code AS roleCode, DATE_FORMAT(m.joined_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS joinedAt FROM team_member m LEFT JOIN personnel p ON p.id = m.personnel_id WHERE m.team_id = #{teamId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_join_request (team_id, personnel_id, type, status, message) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{personnelId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM team_join_request WHERE id = #{requestId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM team_join_request WHERE id = #{requestId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM team_join_request WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND personnel_id = #{personnelId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE team_join_request SET status = #{status}, reviewer_personnel_id = #{reviewerPersonnelId}, reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_audit_log (team_id, actor_personnel_id, action, target_type, target_id, detail) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{actorPersonnelId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail})
